chunks: O you people of the Book, Our Apostle has come to you when apostles had ceased to come long ago, lest you said: 'There did not come to us any messenger of good news or of warnings.' So now there has reached you a bearer of good tidings and of warnings; for God has the power over all things.

key_terms.فَتْرَةٍ مِنَ الرُّسُلِ: Gap or pause in the succession of prophets

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'fatra al-rusul' (gap of the prophets) in Surah Al-Ma'idah?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, the 'gap in prophethood' (fatrat al-rusul) is often interpreted as a period of relative silence or decline in divine guidance, making Muhammad’s (peace be upon him) arrival a decisive restoration of truth. This verse serves as a direct rebuttal to the People of the Book who claimed ignorance due to the absence of recent messengers, affirming that the Prophet brings both glad tidings (bashir) and warnings (nadhir). The mention of God’s omnipotence underscores the certainty of this revelation despite previous doubts.
